WRITING TEST 1
       OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
       WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
       TIME ALLOWED:
       READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
       WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES
       Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.
       Notes:
Patient: Monica Fisher (Mrs.)
DOB: 12/04/1965
Ht: 158 cm
Wt: 85 kg
BMI: 34.04 (08/01/2018)

Social History: Accountant
Married, 3 children (18 yrs, 15 yrs & 12 yrs)
Non-smoker
Social drinker-mainly champagne
Substance Intake: Nil
Allergies: Dust mites, domestic animals fur, sea foods.

FHx: Mother-Diabetes; Asthmatic; Hypercholestrolemia;
Father: Stroke, Hypertension
Maternal grandmother- died in car accident,aged 65
Maternal grandfather-died stroke
Paternal grandmother-died old age 98
Paternal grandfather-unknown

PMHx: Childhood chicken pox; mumps
 
1976 Appendicetomy
1985 UTI
1995 a lump on left breast removed
2005 Hay fever, colds
2007 (July) fainted at office, low Hb level as she is a vegetarian-administered
vitamin B12 injection.
After 2 weeks symptoms stable, work-related stress, mild asthma Rx
Ventolin.
2007(December) started Serevent and Pulmicort turbuhaler as a result of
adverse effects of Ventolin.
2014 Allergic Rhinitis, worsened due to frequent contact with domestic cats-
doctor advised tab. Zyrtex, refered to an Allergic specialist.
14 days later started immunotherapy for allergy to cat fur.
2017(August) Failure of immunotherapy, symptoms are unresolving, she
continued praticising
strict hygiene to avoid allergens; sleeplessness – advised tab. Stilnox 5 mg
for one month.
08/01/2018 Chronic Insomnia since August 2017
Non-healing wounds present in left leg and right forearm.
Weight gain: 10 kg from three months, abdominal obesity.
Severe tiredness, sudden mood change, depressive episodes.
Red face, hirsutism.

Provisional diagnosis: Cushing syndrome
       Writing task:
     Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral for
     further assessment and management of this patient to the
     Endocrinologist, Dr. David Torpy, Royal Adelaide Hospital, Adelaide
     SA, Australia.
       In your answer:
